item.title: Celebrating Women’s History Month at Museums and Sites
item.description: In March, we celebrate all tremendous women during Women’s History Month. Thankfully, our region is home to several museums, exhibits, and sites that offer historic context about female leaders, movements, and culture.

item.title: Maryland DNR to Renovate Albert Powell Fish Hatchery
item.description: The Maryland Department of Natural Resources (DNR) is embarking on a comprehensive renovation of the Albert Powell Fish Hatchery, in partnership with the Department of General Services.

item.title: Maryland’s 2026 Muskrat Trapping Season Extended in Select Maryland Counties
item.description: The revised season will now close March 22 to make up for unfavorable weather conditions in January and February, including extensive ice coverage, that impacted trapping in parts of the state.

item.title: What's Up? This Weekend 3/4
item.description: March is marching in with music, momentum, and plenty of Irish spirit. From intimate live performances and high-energy basketball to creative nights out, grand openings, and a can’t-miss used book sale, the week offers something for every interest.
